construction: Authored procedural guide-based reconstruction. Source game stats determine class and gun counts; metre dimensions and hull offsets are estimates, not extracted stock meshes.

provenance.method: Original procedural construction from authored offsets following repository guide chapters 02–09 and 12–13. No binary game meshes or proprietary textures imported.
